segments.name: Telematics services
segments.description: Provides stolen vehicle recovery, fleet management and value-added tracking services, including connected car, UBI and concierge, to retail, commercial, insurance and car manufacturer customers.
segments.evidence: The telematics services segment consists predominantly of regionally- based stolen vehicle recovery (SVR) services, fleet management services and value-added services that include among others, connected car, UBI (usage base insurance), personal advanced locater services and concierge services.

segments.name: Telematics products
products: short and medium range two-way machine-to-machine wireless communications produc
segments.description: Designs and sells short and medium range two-way wireless communications products used for automatic vehicle location and identification, mainly to support its own services.
segments.evidence: The telematics product segment consists mainly of short and medium range two-way machine-to-machine wireless communications products that are used for various applications, including automatic vehicle location, and automatic vehicle identification.

revenueModel.text: Subscribers, car manufacturers and insurers pay subscription fees for telematics services, and customers pay for the purchase or lease of telematics products.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate our revenues from subscription fees paid for our telematics services and from the sale and lease of our telematics products.
